summary: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines.
takeaways: In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga.

Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines.
Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent.
